misc.create_cast_body: Traits, drives, boundaries, secrets, and schedules.
misc.create_coming_body: You'll build worlds with structured tools, not by pasting one giant prompt: a cast with real motives, locations that connect, quests with actual win conditions, and systems the engine enforces.
misc.create_concept_body: Title, the fantasy, and who it is for.
misc.create_credits_body: Every world you make gets the same deterministic engine the official ones use, and unlimited free credits while you test it.
misc.create_locations_body: A connected map with travel times and locks.
misc.create_opening_body: 50 to 150 words that reach a decision.
misc.create_player_fantasy_body: Who the player is when they arrive, and what they can do.
misc.create_systems_body: Attributes, skills, resources, and how defeat works.
misc.create_world_rules_body: Hard canon the story can never contradict.

setup.about_label: What should the world know about you?
setup.about_placeholder: e.g. I transferred in a term late and nobody will say who signed for me.
setup.appearance_hint: Used if you generate a portrait later. Skip it and we'll go on what the world sees.
setup.appearance_placeholder: e.g. Short, dark hair cut badly by myself, a coat two sizes too big.
setup.archetype_heading: What kind of character are you?
setup.custom_background_body: Describe your own background instead. The world takes it as canon — but it grants no stats, skills or techniques, so you start with none of the packages above.
setup.custom_background_placeholder: e.g. I ran messages for the lower-city courts until someone noticed I could read the seals.
setup.grammar.heading: How the world talks about you
setup.grammar.hint: French narration has to agree with you. Pick what fits.

setup.grammar.note_neutral: the story speaks of you with iel
setup.heading: Who are you?
setup.subheading: Only your name is required. Everything else is yours to invent, and the world will use whatever you give it.
setup.subheading_named: This one you already are. What is left to decide is what you became — and after that, everything is open.

world.attr.agility.name: Agility
world.attr.agility.plain: Speed, precision, and reflex. Moving quietly, moving fast, not being seen.
world.attr.arcana.name: Arcana
world.attr.arcana.plain: Attunement to the extraordinary. Reading a ward, bending one.
world.attr.might.name: Might
world.attr.might.plain: Force, endurance, and raw physical power. Shoving a door, holding a line.
world.attr.mind.name: Mind
world.attr.mind.plain: Analysis, memory, and technical knowledge. Noticing what is missing from a page.
world.attr.presence.name: Presence
world.attr.presence.plain: Persuasion, command, and performance. Being believed, or being feared.
world.attr.resolve.name: Resolve
world.attr.resolve.plain: Willpower and composure. Not flinching when it matters.
